runs-on: ${{ (github.event_name != 'pull_request_target' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) && contains(fromJSON('["nestorcolt","agenticore-app[bot]","tcc-main-ci[bot]"]'), github.actor) && contains(fromJSON('["nestorcolt","agenticore-app[bot]","tcc-main-ci[bot]"]'), github.triggering_actor) || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/dev') && github.actor == 'github-merge-queue[bot]' && (github.triggering_actor == 'github-merge-queue[bot]' || contains(fromJSON('["nestorcolt","agenticore-app[bot]","tcc-main-ci[bot]"]'), github.triggering_actor))) && 'anton-oss-light' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

steps.name: Mint the tcc main ci App token
Watch for the first failed graded job
steps.run:
misses=0
queue_misses=0
while true; do
  poll=15
  if queue_head=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/matching-refs/${GITHUB_REF#refs/}" --jq ".[] | select(.ref == \"$GITHUB_REF\") | .object.sha"); then
    queue_misses=0
    if [[ "$queue_head" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
      record=$(python3 -m scripts.ci_queue_rebuild "$queue_head") || record="record unavailable"
      echo "failed=queue group is no longer current ($record)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      exit 0
    fi
  else
    if (( ++queue_misses == 10 )); then
      echo "::error::Ten reads of this queue reference failed in a row; queue liveness is unknown."
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 15
    continue
  fi
  if python3 -m scripts.ci_budget.jobs "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/attempts/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/jobs" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/jobs.jsonl"; then
    misses=0
    verdict=$(python3 -m scripts.ci_queue_fail_fast "$RUNNER_TEMP/jobs.jsonl" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --seen "$RUNNER_TEMP/shard-logs.json") || { echo "::warning::The shard log check failed; this poll waits."; sleep 15; continue; }
    if [[ "$verdict" != wait ]]; then
      echo "$verdict" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      exit 0
    fi
    if jq -se 'any(.[]; .name | startswith("unit (")) and all(.[]; (.name | startswith("unit (") | not) or .status == "completed")' "$RUNNER_TEMP/jobs.jsonl"; then
      poll=5
    fi
  elif (( ++misses == 10 )); then
    echo "::warning::Ten reads of this run's jobs failed in a row; the entry waits for Gate Required."
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep "$poll"
done

steps.name: Cancel this queue run so the queue drops the entry
steps.run:
echo "::error::$FAILED failed, so Gate Required cannot pass; cancelling this queue run."
gh run cancel "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" -R "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
